en.short_description: Your morning briefing: news, weather, air quality and your stock watchlist.
en.description:
Daily Pulse puts the things you check every morning on one screen, then lets you shape the rest.

—— The morning dashboard ——

A greeting, live weather and air quality for where you are, your stock watchlist, and the day's top stories. One scroll instead of four apps.

—— Feeds that respect your mood ——

GOOD NEWS
Articles scored as positive by sentiment analysis. A real feed, not a gimmick — some mornings you want the news without the dread.

ALERTS
The opposite filter: critical and negative-sentiment breaking stories, when you do want to know.

WORLD NEWS
Global headlines with country-level filtering and hashtag navigation.

MY FEED
Shaped by the interests and location you set.

—— Pages you create by asking ——

Tell the built-in assistant what you want and it builds the page:

• "Add a crypto page" — a live crypto page from CoinGecko
• "Add local news for Tokyo" — a geo-scoped news page
• "What's the weather?" — live conditions for your city
• "Give me today's briefing" — a location and weather summary

The assistant runs on a rule-based engine on your device. It does not send your conversation to an external AI service.

—— Nine languages ——

English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese and Chinese.

—— Where the data comes from ——

Weather and air quality from Open-Meteo, crypto from CoinGecko, and public news sources. Named openly, because you should know what your morning briefing is built on.

en.release_notes:
First release of Daily Pulse.

• Morning dashboard: weather, air quality, stock watchlist and the day's top stories
• Good News feed, scored by sentiment
• Alerts feed for critical and negative-sentiment breaking news
• World News with country filtering and hashtag navigation
• My Feed, shaped by your interests and location
• Ask the assistant to build a page - crypto, local news, weather or a briefing
• Nine languages

The assistant runs on-device and does not send your conversation to an external AI service.

Feedback: contact@safecodeg.com

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Daily Pulse puts the things you check every morning on one screen, then lets you shape the rest.

Intended audience:
News, weather, air & markets

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- device location services (on-device)
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (ar, de, en, es, fr, hi, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
